cards.title: Teacup Town Weather Window Story Clue Trail Card

cards.adultSetup: Adult: set one manila folder, blank page, pencil, and pretend weather-window clue trail card on the table: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: follow the clue trail on paper by making each Teacup Town clue pretend and broad: ____________________.

cards.turningCluePrompt: Turning clue: invent the calm page moment when the weather-window clue starts to mean something new: ____________________.

cards.returnCluePrompt: Return clue: bring back the first weather-window sign so the later page connects to the start: ____________________.
cards.folderLabelPrompt: Folder label: write the broad pretend folder label for this Teacup Town manila folder clue trail: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill only the first clue and folder label blanks before adding more clue trail notes: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: restart this paper clue trail later with one pretend teacup-window folder label: ____________________.
